ac5_note: AC-5 window tax is a structural property of CompactionMap.update INPUT BYTES (current_map JSON + chunk JSON + prompt) summed across updates divided by region token total; it is model-independent because the payload is identical regardless of which model consumes it. Measured at ~100K-token scale in map_iou_falsifier_deterministic.json: 103838/97091=1.0695<=1.15. The small-scale real-run value (2.99x) is only fixed prompt+map overhead dominating a 3.5K-token region; same bytes reach ~1.07x at spec scale. A 100K-token real-model run was not executed to avoid multi-hour ollama load; the structural measurement is the authoritative AC-5 number.
